dialogues.speaker: Slightly Aged Notice
dialogues.text: "By the grace of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, and in accordance with the Imperial Edict on the Strengthening of Order, the area ahead is now designated as a Military Administrative Area."

dialogues.speaker: Slightly Aged Notice
dialogues.text: "Unauthorized entry is prohibited. Intruders will be regarded as hostile agents engaged in espionage and sabotage, and will be neutralized in accordance with the aforementioned regulations."
